label: Bible Study
prompt: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is _____ of all.
verse: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.
note: Break one link and the whole chain is broken — James on keeping the law.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: There is none holy as the LORD: for there is none beside thee: neither is there any _____ like our God.
verse: There is none holy as the LORD: for there is none beside thee: neither is there any rock like our God.
note: Hannah's song of thanks: none holy as the LORD, and no rock like our God.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus, that all the world should be _____.
verse: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.
note: The Christmas story starts with paperwork: Caesar's decree that 'all the world should be taxed' sent Joseph to Bethlehem.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Behold, he cometh with _____; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.
verse: Behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.
note: Echoing Daniel 7:13 and Zechariah 12:10 — the one they pierced returns in full public view.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Beware lest any man spoil you through _____ and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.
verse: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.
note: Paul's warning to Colossae: don't let anyone 'spoil' you — carry you off as plunder — through hollow philosophy.
